# Loewen Double-Hung (DH) Window Research Findings

## PRODUCT OVERVIEW
**Manufacturer:** Loewen Windows  
**Country of Origin:** Canada (Steinbach, Manitoba)  
**Material Class:** Wood-clad (Aluminum-clad Coastal Douglas Fir or Honduran Mahogany)  
**Configuration:** Double-Hung (DH)  

## CONFIRMED FINDINGS

### Performance Data

**U-Factor:** 0.35 (Loewen 25 Series Window)  
**SHGC:** 0.30 (Loewen 25 Series Window)  
**VT:** 0.30 (Loewen 25 Series Window)


For StormForce impact series: 
U-Factor: 0.25, SHGC: 0.28, Air Infiltration: 0.02


For Cyprium Collection: 
U-Factor: 0.35, SHGC: 0.23, VT: 0.31


### Material Construction  

Frame Material: Coastal Douglas Fir (standard) or Honduran Mahogany
  

Cladding: Pre-finished extruded aluminum, set away from underlying wood to create air space for improved thermal performance
  

Paint: 70% Kynar 500 PVDF resin meeting AAMA 2605 specification


### Glazing System

Dual seal on glass units for long hermetic seal life
  

Standard IGUs manufactured by Cardinal Glass Industries with stainless steel spacers warranted for 20 years (aluminum spacers 10 years)


### Hardware & Operations

Innovative balance system for smooth operation, single-handed lock/tilt mechanism for inward tilting sash cleaning or removal
  

Dark colored weatherstripping consistent with all product lines
  

Two types of weatherstripping offered for added insulation


### Warranty Coverage

Transferable warranty applying to products purchased and installed in the United States
  

Limited warranty covering glass, paint, and wood components for 20 years for all metal-clad products. Some glass and window spacer types warranted for only 10 years
  

Labor coverage: Loewen covers labor costs for replacing/repairing components in areas within sixty (60) miles of original point of purchase. Otherwise, labor and/or mileage expenses may be charged


### Structural Performance

Construction utilizes authentic stile and rail construction with mortise and tenon joinery at sash corners for enhanced stability rather than simple mitered joints
